propositions: SupportsIncremental protocol has zero implementers and zero dispatch sites despite a docstring claiming incremental fetch dispatch behaviour
No adapter defines search_incremental and no isinstance(backend, SupportsIncremental) check exists in src/
The false-assurance docstring claims core uses incremental fetch conditionally, but full-scan fetch via _build_snapshot is the only fetch path in use
Removing SupportsIncremental changes no externally observable reconciler behaviour since full-scan already runs unconditionally
Two test cases test_backends_without_incremental_are_detected and test_dc_backend_is_deliberately_not_incremental guard a skip branch that remains covered by retained SupportsLinks negative tests
